name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Hold two kettlebells at your shoulders, elbows tucked, feet shoulder width.
Squat down with your chest up to a depth where your back stays flat.
Drive up out of the squat and use that push to press both bells overhead.
Lock your arms out with the bells over your head, then lower them to your shoulders.
Flow straight into the next squat.
cues: Elbows close, chest up in the squat
Legs start the press, arms finish it
Breathe in down, breathe out as you press

common_mistakes.fix: Stand up fast and let the leg drive move the bells
Squeeze glutes and stomach and keep ribs down

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbows dropping and chest folding in the squat
common_mistakes.fix: Keep elbows up in front and use lighter bells
